viewportNote: OhMyToken main window is hardcoded to 400x640 (tray app, fixed size). The original gate-doc §7 U1-VR spec called for 1440x900 but that produces a layout users never see. U1-VR-b (2026-05-10) decided to keep 400x640 to match the shipped layout, since CSS decomposition regressions are most likely to surface in the actual user-facing render path. Sidecar JSON's targetViewport == actualPx now.

screens.name: settings-evidence
screens.description: Evidence scoring settings popup: navigate to PromptDetailView (same as dashboard-prompt-detail), then click .evidence-settings-btn (PromptDetailView.tsx:203). The button is inside a lazy-mounted Section so .prompt-detail-header alone isn't sufficient — wait explicitly for the button selector before clicking.
screens.tbd: (U1-VR-b finding) `.evidence-settings-btn` is only rendered when `hasInjectedFiles=true` (PromptDetailView.tsx:77, 192), which requires `displayScan.injected_files` to be a non-empty array. The populated fixture's prompts seed `tool_summary` (Read/Edit counts) but NOT `injected_files` rows in the DB. Fixture enrichment needed: add at least one prompt with seeded injected_files entries linked via the prompts.injected_files JSON column or join table. Tracked as fixture-enrichment follow-up; orchestrator path is correct.

screens.name: notification-overlay
screens.description: Notification overlay renders in a separate frameless BrowserWindow (src/notification-main.tsx) when a new prompt scan event fires. Cross-cut guard for §9.1.
screens.tbd: (P0.5.2) Skipped under OMT_QA_CAPTURE_MODE=1 — the notification BrowserWindow is not created in capture mode (creates CDP target ambiguity). To capture this screen the orchestrator would need to (a) launch Electron WITHOUT OMT_QA_CAPTURE_MODE, (b) trigger a notification, (c) tab-switch to the notification window, (d) capture via CDP — but agent-browser's CDP screenshot is unreliable in multi-tab scenarios (the original P0.5 blocker). U1-VR can decide to either drop this canonical screen, add a separate launch mode that captures only the notification window solo, or accept manual capture. Tracked separately.
